items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Him and Dick Allen was at the week there... [INTERVIEWEE] No. I'm sorry to say, but I know.

ctx.x: Yeah. Him and Dick Allen was at the week there. Boyk. Yeah. He liked him plenty. I never did get to know you, son.

No. I'm sorry to say, but I know. Raymond came by that very night. He was a pretty good son of a player, Johnny. Yeah, I had a boy. Swell draft player. Yeah. Swell draft player. Yeah. I'm not a player. You start to say something about your son a few minutes ago, but he never was very big or strong, really.
